verdict.rationale: Railway's marketing states 'Run your application closer to where your users are' (railway-docs-7), implying regional placement, but there is no documentation describing automatic compute placement based on backend data location, nor any mechanism for optimizing latency to databases specifically. Community threads also reveal outages and platform instability, raising doubt about reliability of any such placement feature. missing for 10: technical details on automatic placement logic, evidence of data-aware compute scheduling, independent verification of latency optimization.
